sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

As a family-run foundry, we deeply value our long relationship and take great pride in the dedication of our skilled team. In light of current market conditions, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. 

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €52.90 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our trustful cooperation and working together with you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

Guten Tag,
Many thanks for your message; I have read it carefully together with my people here at the foundry, and we have given it the attention it deserves.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €51.90 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026.
Let me tell you how we see it from our side.
We value our long-standing relationship and are willing to make a concession to €51.90 to keep our partnership strong.
We have worked together for many years, and I am confident that we will find a fair way forward, as we always have between our two houses.
Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and hold our Angebot. 

Our family foundry has always valued the long standing relationship between Demo Gießerei GmbH and Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, and we take great pride in the quality our team delivers. We have already made a concession in our last offer to accommodate you. As you have not adjusted your proposal, we must maintain our current offer of €51.90.

For your reference, our offer stands at a price of €51.90 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

We look forward to a revised proposal from your side that reflects a step towards an agreement.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and hold our Angebot. 

Over the years, our foundry has always valued the strong partnership between our companies and the quality work we deliver together for our region. In this spirit, we notice that your proposal remains unchanged once again. As a family-run business that values our long-standing partnership, we would appreciate understanding the reasoning behind your position.

We must maintain our offer of €51.90 and suggest a meeting to discuss how we can move forward constructively. For your review, our current offer stands at a price of €51.90 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that our offer stays valid for 30 days.

We look forward to an open conversation and to finding a path forward that serves us both well.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

Guten Tag,

We have received your unchanged proposal once again, and as a proud family-run foundry, we expect a genuine dialogue rather than repeated identical messages. Since you have not moved from your initial position despite our previous concession, we must now declare our offer of €51.90 as our final offer. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.

Ourangebot stands at a price of €51.90 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. This offer remains valid for 7 days.

We remain available for a meeting to discuss this properly, should you wish to continue our partnership.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
